lines: The wind is a little strong.
It shakes my heart too much.
I miss you, the you I once stared at earnestly.
Days that tumble upside down.
Feigning sorrow.
I tried being lazy, though.
The light of hope
shines forever before me—it's happiness.
You in the straw hat
resemble the swaying marigold.
That was a summer when the sky was still blue.
the love of that day we could laugh at as nostalgic.
"Don't ever let go,"
you, staring with eyes about to cry
with a cloud‑like tenderness, gently yet tightly
Hold me, hold me, never let go.
All my true feelings
aren't strong enough to spill out.
Yet, strangely enough
despair is invisible.
A silhouette that remains etched deep in my eyes.
I love you.
Our soft skins pressed together
the two of us breathing a slightly cold air
gripping it, we walk on this day called today—how...
talking about whether to give it a name
Ah, the words I love you
aren't enough, so we kiss.
because the clouds still leave our shadows.
Forever, forever, just like this.
Even if we're in a faraway place
I want us to stay connected.
May the two of our feelings be the same.
